acceptance: Fork fix with executed sqlite3 tests showing Q21-shape ratios match DuckDB; carried patch recorded in the manifest.
Corpus diff lists every shipped query whose SQLite output changes and the row-level effect on a DuckDB oracle; unexpected differences stop for the owner.
Adopted through a wheel adoption PR; published SQLite results using affected queries listed.
description: The SQLite rerun (report ~/Developer/benchmark_runs/sqlite-day-offset-rerun-20261021/REPORT.md) found that TPC-DS Q21 divides two integer sums (inv_after / inv_before), which SQLite truncates, so Q21 on SQLite differs from DuckDB on every one of 80 parameter draws; old and new wheels emit the same text. Per the owner's most-correct-result rule, the fork's SQLite generator (or a named rewrite) should preserve the SQL-standard numeric semantics of integer/decimal division by casting the numerator to REAL (or equivalent) where the dividend is not already floating point, with an executed sqlite3 test and a corpus diff; behavior for queries where both operands are explicitly integer-typed keys needs a rule so legitimate integer division is not altered. Published SQLite results containing affected queries must be listed and flagged.
